sentences.en: What was it that caused you to change your mind?
sentences.zh: 是什么原因让你改变主意的？

sentences.en: Eating too much fat is supposed to cause heart disease.
sentences.zh: 过多摄入脂肪据说是会导致心脏病的。

sentences.en: It transpired that fire was caused by a careless smoker.
sentences.zh: 原来火灾是由于粗心的大意吸烟者引起的。
